name: Jaw exerciser

lead: A jaw exerciser is a silicone or plastic device, often a ball or resistance trainer, that the user bites or chews against to work the masseter and related chewing muscles. It is promoted on social media for a sharper, more defined jawline.
The devices sit in the looksmaxxing space alongside hard gum and chewing routines, where bigger jaw muscles are assumed to equal better jaw definition.

paras: Resistance chewing loads the masseter and temporalis, which can increase muscle stiffness, endurance and in some cases size. Muscle growth widens the lower face at the angle of the jaw rather than removing fat or changing bone structure.

There is no controlled trial showing the devices improve jawline definition; the available literature is small studies on muscle stiffness and a two-person case report finding no change in the jawline or double chin. Overuse can strain the temporomandibular joint and cause jaw pain, headaches and tooth wear, so the marketing is ahead of the anatomy. Anyone with TMJ symptoms should avoid them.
